_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Provisioning Data Cover Page
summary: The Provisioning Data Cover Page records the data required to identify the end item being provisioned, supporting full-support and configuration-only provisioning and establishment of Advance Repairable Identification Codes (RICs).
description_purpose: The Provisioning Data Cover Page will be used to record the data required to identify the end item being provisioned. It will be used to support full-support provisioning, configuration-only provisioning, and for the establishment of Advance Repairable Identification Codes (RICs).
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This data item description contains the content and format preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement delineated in the contract.

7.2 This DID is used as part of the provisioning process. It is related to DID DI-ILSS-81285, Provisioning Technical Documentation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Provisioning Data Cover Page shall be the NAVSEA Form 4423/3.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Provisioning Data Cover Page shall contain the data fields as specified on the DD Form 1423 Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL).

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The media required for this cover page shall be specified on the DD Form 1423 Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL).

preparation_instructions.title: The cover page shall be prepared
preparation_instructions.content: for each Provisioning Contract Control Number (PCCN) package for which a Provisioning Parts List (PPL) is submitted, for each PCCN package that will be submitted (Advanced RICs), and for each PCCN package for which a configuration-only (CoRIC) will be developed.
